Inclusion-exclusion and a 7^6 scan agree on 7872 length-15 vectors, of which exactly 60 are weight-3, all permutations of (6,6,1,1,1,0). The three other residue shapes of sum 15 are weight-3 and are not prefixes. The recorded budget equations have the six PR #7029 type-counts, and none of their four q_18 multisets dominates the named shape through a three-letter bridge. The representative prefix has C(3+4-1, 3)=20 first-gap bridges and 397 enumerated bridge pairs, the orbit has 23820, and none is weight-3. The non-shape prefix (0,0,0,6,6,3) has 372 bridge pairs and 13 weight-3 extensions, all carrying a 12. Nineteen controls cover the predicate, the closed count, the orbit, the family equations, both explicit floor words, and the live enumerator control.
Same census and controls under optimized Python. Failures are SystemExit, not assertions.
